major: Reworked Kumori's gameplay pipeline to keep blocking and unbounded work off gameplay-critical threads, targeting cursor freezes and latency spikes during play
improvements: tosu packet parsing and attempt tracking now use bounded queues, bounded caches, and allocation-light in-memory processing
osu!stable and osu!lazer replay discovery and capture now run on isolated low-priority workers, using bounded discovery and deferring nonessential work until gameplay is idle
Database writes, replay archiving, compression, backups, recovery, media loading, dashboard hydration, and diagnostics now run on cancellable background paths
Standardized every user-visible date to dd/MM/yyyy while retaining ISO timestamps for storage, logs, and serialized data
Update checks now follow canonical GitHub release redirects without relying on GitHub API requests
Cut GitHub release wait time by validating main once while the versioned Windows package builds in parallel
Moved the osu!stable accuracy notice into the Replay Analyzer timeline so skin accuracy HUDs remain unobstructed
fixes: Removed synchronous SQLite, file, process, display, and native memory-scan work from gameplay-critical threads
Made OpenTabletDriver start in the tray and follow Kumori's lifetime, automatically refreshing its cached monitor layout after resolution changes without overwriting saved OTD settings
Required tosu restarts after recovered results now wait until gameplay is safe, coalesce duplicate requests, and retry until tracking is restored
Made deferred attempt persistence ordered, retryable, and interruption-safe to avoid incomplete or duplicated play data
Hardened stable and lazer replay finalization, persistence, recovery, and cancellation against shutdown stalls, partial output, and ordering races
Preserved exact recovered accuracy and hit-result data when repairing incomplete attempts

Cleared stale replay counters, process details, and persisted-replay diagnostics between runs and attempts so the capture window reports only current data
Reset late asynchronous replay-detection state after gameplay so it cannot suppress the next genuine play
Restored immediate database hydration and post-commit dashboard and inspector refreshes without repeated maintenance-queue delays

Made replay writes wait for their durable attempt row, retain captured frames across transient failures, and drain safely during shutdown
Reduced startup and automatic-refresh database work by loading visible history first and aggregating only the sessions shown on that page
Made workspace cleanup continue past locked outputs, safely collapse nested build targets, and report reclaimed sizes above 2 GB correctly
Made release publishing restore every project after a clean workspace, including the win-x86 stable replay bridge
Corrected recovered plays that retained tosu's placeholder 100% accuracy and added startup repair for already-saved affected attempts
Kept osu!stable's prewarmed memory bridge alive across empty pre-play discards and locked validated replay lists sooner so short or failed plays retain cursor data
Prevented osu!lazer's skin importer from consuming Kumori's library archives and stopped unavailable skin paths from silently changing the selected default
Moved the stable-result accuracy notice into a dedicated row beneath the Replay Analyzer seeker
Restored osu!stable memory capture by dynamically rediscovering the live replay list instead of relying on changing memory addresses or obfuscated type names
Limited osu!stable fallback heap discovery to active attempts in a non-suspending, below-normal-priority bridge, stopping discovery as soon as the actively growing replay list is locked
